This small maize piece is near home, so I will use what I already have first. I do not want to buy a whole fertilizer bag for such a small plot, and at my age I do not like risking cash on a thing I have not seen pay well on a piece this small. I will plant my usual seed, put manure on it, weed it with family hands, and wait for the rain because I do not irrigate maize here.
